content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway is an infrastructure solution enabling digital creators to accept cryptocurrency payments directly for their products, such as ebooks, courses, templates, and more. This matters because it eliminates reliance on traditional payment platforms that often charge exorbitant fees and require extensive verification processes. For instance, while Gumroad takes a hefty 10% from every sale, a service like NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This substantial difference in fees allows creators to retain more of their earnings, which can add up significantly when selling multiple products.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a crypto payment gateway involves several components working in harmony. At its core, it utilizes a backend logic system, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, to process orders. When a customer makes a purchase, these systems handle payment verification via NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. The transaction is confirmed on-chain, enabling automatic delivery of digital products. This infrastructure ensures that creators maintain control over their data and transactions, fostering true ownership of their commerce stack without reliance on external platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or heavily restricted. It caters to those who sell a variety of digital products, from ebooks and courses to software and templates. By using a crypto payment gateway, these creators can bypass traditional barriers, retain full ownership of their assets, and enjoy lower transaction fees. This approach empowers them to build sustainable businesses without being hindered by the limitations imposed by mainstream financial systems.
Now you can retain more of your earnings with a 0.5% fee instead of 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component of the crypto payment gateway plays a vital role in creating a seamless selling experience. Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages are used for hosting, providing a reliable platform for the storefront. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 facilitates file delivery, ensuring that purchased products reach customers instantly. NOWPayments integrates the payment process, allowing transactions in various cryptocurrencies. By combining these technologies, digital creators can establish a robust infrastructure that not only supports their current needs but also scales with their growing business.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To leverage this infrastructure, begin by selecting a suitable stack for your needs, such as the Sovereign Starter Stack for quick deployment. Set up your hosting using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, then configure your backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions and ensure your delivery system is in place using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, load your digital products and test the entire workflow to ensure everything operates smoothly. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) which includes all necessary blueprints and templates for your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe can be done effectively by using a crypto payment gateway. By adopting a solution like NOWPayments, you can accept cryptocurrency directly, allowing for instant transactions and delivery without the usual platform fees. This empowers you to retain more of your earnings while providing a frictionless purchase experience for your customers.
Ownership of your infrastructure means no more dependency on external platforms.

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Select a suitable stack for your digital products, such as the Sovereign Starter Stack. Set up your hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Integrate NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. Ensure file delivery is established using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Load your initial digital products and conduct thorough testing of the entire system.

You can sell an ebook online by using a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, bypassing the need for traditional payment processors.

The best way to avoid platform fees when selling digital downloads is to utilize a self-hosted solution with a crypto payment gateway. This setup minimizes transaction costs and provides full ownership of your sales.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without conventional platforms like Gumroad or Payhip by deploying your own sales infrastructure with a crypto payment gateway, ensuring lower fees and increased control.
What are the benefits of using a crypto payment gateway?

Using a crypto payment gateway offers lower transaction fees, faster payment processing, and greater control over your sales data, enabling you to build a sustainable digital business without traditional barriers.
How can I ensure instant delivery of my digital products?

You can ensure instant delivery of your digital products by utilizing services like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage and setup automation through backend logic integrated with your payment processing.
